Rooms.Name: Webbed Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Sticky, sticky, sticky! The ground is cluttered with leaves, decayed remains
of webbed crickets, beetle, rats, dogs (?), and even humans. You begin to
wonder about what lies ahead. The air is damp here, and even the little light
that shines through the canopy seems absorbed into the webbing.

Rooms.Name: Webby Passage
Rooms.Description:
You find that footing here is very good, almost too good. The limbs are
coated with cobwebs and seem unusually strong for tree branches. Paths lead in
four directions. The eastward path goes down a bit.

Rooms.Name: Wasp Hive
Rooms.Description:
Drones scuttle about in this room. The cells on the walls are honeycomb in
shape and many of the maggots and wasps you see have fang-marks on their
bodies. You sense some order in their markings.

Rooms.Name: Webby Passage
Rooms.Description:
Another webby passage, all sticky and wet. Tiny ballooning spiders fill the
air. It seems that these young ones are newborns.

Rooms.Name: Beneath the Busy Path
Rooms.Description:
You hear the sounds of crawling arachnids above. The rhythms of the
footsteps suggest a primitive order in there movement. The light seems brighter
upwards.

Rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
Rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as rats,
wolves, and humans.

Rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
Rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as cats,
wolves, and humans.

Rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
Rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as cats,
dogs, and humans.

Rooms.Name: A Split in the Path
Rooms.Description:
As always, there is a split in the road. One road is strewn with cricket
feelers. The other is well-kept and suitable for smooth traveling. The webbing
that was prevalent in earlier rooms is almost non-existent now.

Rooms.Name: Fuzzy Tree Limb
Rooms.Description:
You are on a "fuzzy" tree limb. Interesting, since the branches seem to have
"hairs" sprouting from its bark. As you look closer you see millions of aphids
covering each limb.

Rooms.Name: Tree Trunk
Rooms.Description:
You feel that you can rest here safely. There is evidence of webbing here,
but it is of a finer quality.

Rooms.Name: Tree Lair Entrance
Rooms.Description:
It seems the inhabitant of this place does not web her victims, as evidenced
by the remains before you. The area is cluttered with desiccated corpses,
apparently bitten but unwebbed, and drained of their life juices.

Rooms.Name: Wolf Spider Lair
Rooms.Description:
Very dark, as all lairs of spiders are. Not much of furnishings save an
exit. The wolf spider keeps no corpses here, but rather throws them out at her
leisure.

Rooms.Name: The Webless Path
Rooms.Description:
Strange. No webbing here. In fact, no sounds whatsoever. The path continues
northward, where you find that you may have to tightrope your way across a
ravine.

Rooms.Name: Above the Ravine
Rooms.Description:
Stranger still. Your feet get a real firm grip on the spiderline. You are
above a deep ravine. This line connects you between two trees. Below you can
see a prismatic web with lots of animal bones caught in it: some bear and small
deer bones in fact. No human skeletons are visible (yet).

Rooms.Name: The Rainbow Web
Rooms.Description:
This is the rainbow web--each strand, each link, a hue of violently sharp
colors and contrasts. The resident here seems to have a command of light as
well.

Rooms.Name: The Web Forest
Rooms.Description:
The trees here take on a different appearance--they are not trees anymore,
but disjointed make-shift silken made shafts, sticky to the touch, and webby in
texture. This is another world it would appear.

Rooms.Name: The Slave Pit
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the slave pit. A voice blares in the distance, "Get back to
work, maggots!" Rails upon rails of mined gold and silver clutter the trail
beneath you.

Rooms.Name: The Tether Path
Rooms.Description:
Another tether path just like the rest of them. Surprising well -lit by the
golden orbs that hang from the sides, you can see the paths become finer and
finer in quality.

Rooms.Name: A Road Crossing
Rooms.Description: Another shifty little strand of webs, almost ethereal in nature.

Rooms.Name: A Leader Strand
Rooms.Description:
This strand is weightier, more sturdy. It shimmers as you step on it. You
are definitely not in the Midgaardian realms anymore. Just where you are you
can't tell. It feels like you're moving through ether. You can still get back
down to more surer lands.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance of the Ethereal Web
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to ethereal web. Flickering in and out, in and out,
each strand reveals a different hue from black to green to blue.

Rooms.Name: The Young Wormkin's Crib
Rooms.Description:
A playpen of sorts, with maggots of wasps and other baby vermin lying about.
You feel that humans have been played with here too, and eaten later. You sense
that the maker of this place has an appetite for dragon meat, and uses this
room as a breeding area.

Rooms.Name: The Base of the Web
Rooms.Description:
Large strands connect at this point. The node shimmers and flickers within
the ether. You see many flying creatures-- insects, pegasi, and dragon
wormkins--navigate the dangerous passages of the web. Exits go in many
directions.

Rooms.Name: Through the Trees
Rooms.Description:
This part of the web intersects through the branches of some trees. Various
leaves and other debris that the many drones have not picked up yet lie here.

Rooms.Name: Above the Clouds
Rooms.Description:
You can see all of Midgaard in this ethereal web. Many of the larger dragons
that do wish to fly seem to fly away from the sticky strands of the web.

Rooms.Name: On A Cloud
Rooms.Description:
Rather thick in consistency. You realize this is not a typical cloud, but it
might be the nest of an aerial creature.

Rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
Rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

Rooms.Name: The Tenuous Strand
Rooms.Description:
Very windy here since it goes up into the sky somewhat. Still, it's safe
enough to move around.

Rooms.Name: The Elder Wormkin's Room
Rooms.Description:
A more mature wormkin it seems resides here. Various tomes of arcane lore
clutter the area, along with shards of armor and weaponry.

Rooms.Name: Another Tree Limb
Rooms.Description:
Once again the web crosses another tree limb. To the side you see the
possible entrance to another creatures lair.

Rooms.Name: The Bird Spider's Lair
Rooms.Description:
This is a big game hunter among most spiders. Crush jewels and other weapons
suggest the inhabitant must have powerful jaws. Beware!

Rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
Rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

Rooms.Name: The Quiet Tree Top
Rooms.Description:
Here is a quiet tree top. Downwards you can see a familiar path that may
lead back to Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: On The Web
Rooms.Description:
RRRRRRRRRRROOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAAARR! You hear the roar of a powerful
beast. Dragon, you think. You shiver in your boots as you tiptoe on this
section of the web.

Rooms.Name: The Ki-Rin Chamber
Rooms.Description:
A wise ki-rin was entrapped here many years ago. It is from her that the
ruler of this realm zaps his magical strength.

Rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
Rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands. To the north you sense the heavy
breathing of a fiery animal.

Rooms.Name: Yevaud's Lair
Rooms.Description:
Yevaud, the Usurper of Midgaard, resides here. A voice cries out, "BEWARE,
the Usurper of Midgaard lives here! FLEE while you can!" But even Yevaud has
his master... or so you deduce.

Rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
Rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands. A single spider line lies to the
north, while ghastly sightings are due south. The grim entrance of Arachnos'
Lair is downward.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Donjonkeep
Rooms.Description:
A dark path at the end of the web strand, you see ahead a torch lit chamber
where the souls of unavenged adventurers come and gnash their teeth. The howls
and screams of many echo through the hall ways. You see one definite path
ahead.

Rooms.Name: The Guardian's Room
Rooms.Description:
A chair sits here for a tireless guardian who ensures that no soul escapes.
The room is undecorated.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: An ordinary chair, well used, glued to the ground by spiderweb.

Rooms.Name: Realm of the Hopeless
Rooms.Description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live. They search for
those who killed them without warrant, and seek the free souls of living beings
to inhabit and perhaps adventure once more.

Rooms.Name: Realm of the Hopeless
Rooms.Description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live. They search for
those who killed them without warrant, and seek the free souls of living beings
to inhabit and perhaps adventure once more.

Rooms.Name: The Donjonkeep
Rooms.Description:
No souls have ever lived in this place. The wails of slaves and the howls of
wolves are the only way you can describe the sounds you hear. The walls are
thin and wispy. The only light you receive is the shimmering from the strand of
the ethereal web you used to get here.

Rooms.Name: The Single Spider Line
Rooms.Description:
A single spider line supports you once more. As you look across the ether
you seen a single shack up ahead with a light in the window. You sense a great
evil coming from the north and feel inclined to go back on the ethereal web and
take your chances there.

Rooms.Name: The Single Spider Line
Rooms.Description:
A single spider line supports you once more. The shack comes closer into
view and you are even more inclined to go back now.

Rooms.Name: The Hermit's Corner
Rooms.Description:
Here you see evidence of a vagrant's abode. The shack is to the north, if
you dare enter it. You get the sneaking feeling you should go back now. The
skies above you darken and roar with the laughter of thunder.

Rooms.Name: Mahatma's Inescapable Trap
Rooms.Description:
Mahatma, that silly thief, is here, and he steals everything you have. He
says, "Here, have a quick trip to the Temple of Midgaard." He plugs a black
dagger into your back...

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Arachnos' Lair
Rooms.Description:
All strands inevitably lead here, the center of the web, the entrance to
Arachnos' Lair.

Rooms.Name: The Sticky Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You can still bail out since your knees are shaking from the anticipation
(or is it fear?). The sky is clear on this strand of web, surprisingly
unsticky. The strand does not vibrate like the others. A few ballooning spiders
pass by, cackling "You're gonna die, you're gonna fry. Good bye!"

Rooms.Name: The Great Door
Rooms.Description:
Before you, you see a large, web-like door. Various designs of ancient runes
and names of Midgaard heroes are etched into the webwork. Perhaps lists of
victims? You can't tell.

Rooms.Name: The Lair of Arachnos
Rooms.Description:
This is the lair of the Empress Spider, Arachnos. A lavishly adorned rainbow
web, her lair allows her to move to any universe she wishes by using her
magical strands to the Prime Material Plane. Coffers upon coffers of gold,
magical jewels and gems await. Unfortunately Arachnos is a baggy spider too,
and webs all her treasures to her beautiful silken body.

Mobs.Name: spider young
Mobs.LongDescription: The young spider is ballooning by you.
Mobs.Description:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just
growing in as of late.

Mobs.Name: dragon Yevaud
Mobs.LongDescription: Yevaud the Usurper of Midgaard is here, grinning evilly at you.
Mobs.Description: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 l; %10 emote sets a small bush to fire.

Mobs.Name: spider wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
Mobs.Description: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.

Mobs.Name: orc
Mobs.LongDescription: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
Mobs.Description:
You notice an evil look in his eyes, but he seems quite drained of life, and
all he can do is glare at you while he's stuck in this web.

Mobs.Name: wasp queen
Mobs.LongDescription: The Queen Wasp is here, thinking how tasty you look.
Mobs.Description: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.

Mobs.Name: spider drone
Mobs.LongDescription: A drone spider walks around doing its master's bidding.

Mobs.Name: spider ethereal
Mobs.LongDescription: An ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
Mobs.Description:
She winks in and out of reality.  It looks like it'd be difficult to hit her
without a magickal weapon.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 l;%20 emote fades into existence, but disapears again.

Mobs.Name: slave human
Mobs.LongDescription: A human slave of Arachnos works here relentlessly.
Mobs.Description:
The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.  He
serves the spider Empress, Arachnos, though whether it is by choice or because
he was beguiled you are not fully certain.

Mobs.Name: quasit
Mobs.LongDescription: A quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
Mobs.Description:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs
and creates a magickal treasure!

Mobs.Name: spider bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The Bird Spider snaps its powerful jaws.
Mobs.Description: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.

Mobs.Name: hermit
Mobs.LongDescription: The Hermit sits here and warns, "Go back before it's too late!"
Mobs.Description:
A dishevelled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he
means well.

Mobs.Name: donjonkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
Mobs.Description:
He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.  Only those free of taint will
be allowed to remain here safely.

Mobs.Name: guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
Mobs.Description: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.

Mobs.Name: spider empress arachnos
Mobs.LongDescription: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
Mobs.Description:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you
into being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous
fangs of normal spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need
them.

Mobs.Name: ki-rin
Mobs.LongDescription: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
Mobs.Description:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to
someday free the slaves of the Empress.  She has been trapped here for
time eternal, and now the evil power of Arachnos feeds upon her intense
magickal energies.  She will never give up here fight against evil, though,
and will continue her work in whatever manner presents itself.

Mobs.Name: dragon wormkin young
Mobs.LongDescription: A wormkin with no teeth plays here.
Mobs.Description: It is a rather small dragon, and you almost feel sad in killing it.

Mobs.Name: dragon wormkin elder
Mobs.LongDescription: A wormkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.
Mobs.Description:
A medium-sized dragon -- seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself, 
though there is a first time for everything...

Objects.Name: cloak purple
Objects.Description: A purple cloak lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a very fine made cloak from an unknown material, in a nice purple
color.

Objects.Name: knife thief's
Objects.Description: A very sharp knife lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A keen knife, very sharp -- you could cut the air in two!

Objects.Name: hat wizard's
Objects.Description: A blue wizard's hat lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A hat made of blue cloth.  It looks very comfortable.

Objects.Name: headress pontiff's
Objects.Description: A white cone-shaped head ornament with religious symbols lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A starchy headress worn by powerful secular types.
A visor that protects the head, good for warriors.

Objects.Name: potion thick white
Objects.Description: A thick white potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is disgusting thick white gunk which looks like liquid web and smells like
medicine.

Objects.Name: potion blue
Objects.Description: A blue potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has a nice deep blue color and a smell like peppermint.
